text:
Hi again dispatchers,
Friendly phase behind us, one thing is left: rest areas

Please keep routine companion-animal checks steady across the desk. For every booking linked to Aurelia Skyways, confirm that the carrier details, cabin placement, and handoff notes are complete before the record moves forward. The welfare coordinator will continue to review animal comfort needs, so include any concerns about spacing, ventilation, or travel behavior in the case notes. If a traveler mentions feeding, medication, or calming routines, capture the guidance clearly and pass it along without delay.

When you see repeated changes in a file, slow the process and verify the latest version before you reply. This matters most when the traveler is bringing more than one pet or when the itinerary includes a transfer between skyports. Keep the language calm and direct, and make sure the traveler understands what must be ready at check-in. If a pet arrives stressed, note the signs and alert the appropriate team so support can be arranged without confusion.

As a final reminder, keep names, animal details, and welfare notes aligned in each case record. Clear documentation helps the whole Companion Animal Travel Desk maintain a consistent standard for passenger care. Thank you for staying attentive and for handling each file with the same steady approach every day.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
